verdict.rationale: Deel documents an official MCP server that exposes platform operations (contracts, people, payroll, time) as tools agents can invoke. It works with any MCP client over HTTP transport, and common clients like Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code and ChatGPT handle OAuth2 automatically. A tools reference and a probe confirm the documentation is live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent to the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Deel MCP server exposes Deel platform operations as tools that AI agents and assistants can invoke directly.
Expose contracts, people, payroll, and time data to Claude, ChatGPT, or your own agent with Deel's MCP server.
The Deel MCP server is compatible with any client that implements the Model Context Protocol over HTTP transport.
Most MCP clients (Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop, ChatGPT) handle the OAuth2 authorization flow automatically.
